description: Lusha for Recruiting: Source talent and keep a talent pipeline live.

interface.shortDescription: Source talent and keep a talent pipeline live
interface.longDescription:
Connect Lusha to ChatGPT to source talent, keep a talent pipeline live, and reach people while they are actually approachable — straight from your chat. Lusha holds verified work contact details, employer news and job-change history across hundreds of millions of professional profiles, backed by GDPR, CCPA, SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27701 compliance. Built for sourcing an open position, working a saved pipeline over weeks, and catching the window after a leadership change.

Use Lusha to:
- Source talent for an open position and get an ordered shortlist, each candidate with a reason to approach them now — "I need a senior backend engineer in Berlin"
- Find people who have been in the same job long enough to be open to a move, which is the whole approachability signal — "engineering managers in Amsterdam, two years or more in seat"
- Report only what changed on a saved pipeline: who moved, who was promoted, who newly crossed the tenure threshold — "what has changed on my Berlin pipeline?"
- Catch the weeks after an executive departure, when the layer underneath is most in play — "who is in play at fintechs that just lost engineering leadership?"
- Open contact details for the candidates you name, one at a time, with the cost stated before anything is spent — "get me the email for the top three"
defaultPrompt: I need to hire a senior backend engineer in Berlin
What has changed on my Berlin pipeline since July?
Any engineering leadership departures in European fintech recently?
